# #2883: Patch: practice drops Offer draw because the AI always declines it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

On the practice table there is an Offer draw button. Pressing it does nothing useful: the computer opponent turns down every draw the moment it is offered, so the button is a dead click. After this change practice games simply do not show it, while online games keep it exactly as it is.

## Why

- The AI declines every draw offer at once (`crates/ai/README.md`, R188), so in practice the control can only ever produce a refusal notice; it teaches nothing and reads as broken.
- There is precedent for hiding it where it is meaningless: boards a player can only look at already drop Offer draw and Concede (#2019), and the shared board already branches for practice (result `chip` dialog, the R2102000 lethal hint in `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx`).
- This is new: no open issue covers the draw control, and the rejected/retired draw-adjacent items (#2483 tab title, #439 mulligan coin display) are unrelated. Note the deliberate non-goal: ladder-bot games keep the button, because nothing in the game marks a bot (R2614000) and hiding it there would mark them.

## Proposal

- In practice games only (the worker-driven route in `apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx`), do not offer the Offer draw control in the board menu (`offerDraw` in `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx`, text in `apps/web/src/game/DrawOffer.tsx`); online, hotseat and replays are untouched.
- Keep everything else about draws working in practice: the engine rules, and declining/answering logic the AI uses, do not change.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/DrawOffer.tsx` and their tests; `apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx` as the mode switch. No engine, AI, server or spec change (presentation only, CLAUDE.md rule 7).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A practice game shows no Offer draw control (including the phone bar menu), and its tests assert that.
- [ ] Online 1v1, hotseat and ladder games still offer draws per R36, including the blocked-early title.
- [ ] No engine or AI file changes; the web suite for the touched files passes.

## Size and risks

Tiny: two or three web files plus tests; likely `difficulty:easy`. Risk is a player wanting to practice draw etiquette; the control never worked against the AI, so nothing is lost.
